protocol: Plateaus in sequence: 90 min at 24,000 ft. The rebreather targeted inspired PO2 of 21 kPa at plateaus. On initial ascent and final descent participants breathed chamber air below 10,000 ft. Above 10,000 ft on transitions they breathed 46.5% O2/53.5% N2. The target pressure change rate was 5,000 ft/min, with one-minute VGE stops at successive 5,000-ft increments on initial ascent and final descent.
outcome_window: During the chamber trial. Fixed delayed follow-up is unspecified.
note: The paper reports no DCS in any of the completed experiments. The outcome window is the chamber trial. Eight participants completed all three conditions. Participant linkage to other publications is unresolved.
